content.body:
The MP40 was an extremely successful weapon. Easy and cheap to produce, troops liked it because of its durability and effectiveness. In fact, it was fitted with a rate reducer that limited the rate of fire to a controllable level.
The MP40 was employed by all manner of troops, but was particularly popular with units that were expected to engage in very close-range combat.
content.brief: WEAPON: Maschinenpistole 40 (MP40) AMMO: 9 mm Parabellum MAGAZINE: 32 rounds MUZZLE VELOCITY: 390 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 400-500 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: StiG 24 HE Grenades (4) NbHgn 39 Smoke Grenades (2) Combat Knife
